q: In uniform circular motion, the centripetal force and centripetal acceleration are ____ direction. (2026)
e: In uniform circular motion, both centripetal force and centripetal acceleration point toward the center, so they share the same direction.

q: ____ force in a circular motion is not a real force; it acts really away from the centre of the circle. (2026)
e: Centrifugal force is an apparent or pseudo force that acts outward away from the center in a rotating frame.

q: Centrifugal force in a circular motion is not a ____ force. (2026)
e: Centrifugal force is an inertia-driven pseudo force rather than a real force from physical interactions.

q: When a car drives on a curved flat road (unbanked road), ____ force behaves as a centripetal force. (2026)
e: Friction between the tires and the road surface supplies the necessary centripetal force for turning.

q: ____ is used to measure and regulate the speed of a machine. (2025)
e: A centrifugal governor regulates machine speed using the centrifugal force generated by rotation.

q: Centrifugal force acts radially ____ the centre of the circle. (2025)
e: By definition, centrifugal force acts outwards, directed radially away from the center.

q: When a car in motion takes a sudden turn in a curved path, passengers in the car experience an outward push due to the ____ force acting on them. (2025)
e: The inertia of passengers causes them to feel an outward push, described as centrifugal force in the turning frame.

q: The force that keeps an object moving in a circular path is directed towards the ____ of the circle. (2025)
e: Centripetal force must always point toward the center to maintain circular motion.

q: A satellite orbiting a planet is supported by the ____. (2025)
e: The gravitational force pulling the satellite toward the planet serves as the required centripetal force.

q: An attractive force exists between the sun and the earth in a direction ____ to the path of the earth. (2026)
e: The gravitational attraction acts radially toward the sun, which is perpendicular to the earth's tangential path.

q: An object of mass 2 kg moves in a circle with radius 0.5 m at constant speed of 3ms⁻¹. The net force directed toward the center is ____ N. (2026)
e: Calculated using the centripetal force formula F = mv²/r = (2 × 3²) / 0.5 = 18 / 0.5 = 36 N.
